summary: A community-built hub of code-created worlds. We are establishing the project, its requirements and contribution process before building the application.

currentWork.title: One project, one source of truth
currentWork.detail: Two planning packages consolidated by content, with earlier requirements preserved and original inputs archived locally.

currentWork.title: A place to contribute
currentWork.detail: Public source, contributor guidance, conduct, governance and private security reporting configuration.

currentWork.title: Progress that follows the source
currentWork.detail: Reviewed status data generates this site. Main-branch Actions publishes it with its source revision.

milestones.title: Community foundation
milestones.detail: Repository, project documents, contributor workflow and progress site.

milestones.title: Create, personalize, travel
milestones.detail: Local/browser coding, interpreted world scripts, two original scenes and recoverable local saves.

milestones.title: Shared rooms and text
milestones.detail: Authoritative state, membership and tested access boundaries.

milestones.title: Proximity and party voice
milestones.detail: Media lifecycle, routing, resource limits and forbidden-delivery tests.

milestones.title: Trusted world publishing
milestones.detail: Validated immutable releases, revocation, rollback and quarantine.

milestones.title: Public readiness
milestones.detail: Eligibility, privacy, rights, real-device evidence and sustainable operations must be established.

contributionAreas.title: Research
contributionAreas.detail: Verify assumptions using primary sources and make the tradeoffs clear.

contributionAreas.title: Accessibility
contributionAreas.detail: Review journeys, keyboard alternatives, errors and readable project information.

contributionAreas.title: Architecture
contributionAreas.detail: Help define small, testable SDK and runtime boundaries before implementation.

contributionAreas.title: Documentation
contributionAreas.detail: Improve acceptance criteria, contributor onboarding and evidence quality.

limits: No application, public accounts, multiplayer or voice service is available yet. Planned features and research do not establish release, device, security or child-safety readiness.
